captions.title: Ask in plain words
captions.body: One sentence about a 44,714-row file on disk. No schema, no SQL, nothing pasted into the chat.

captions.title: The chart prints in the reply
captions.body: TinyPivot read every row on your machine. Claude received a summary of about 540 tokens.

captions.title: Follow up for a few hundred tokens
captions.body: The file is already loaded, so the next question sends only the new instruction.

captions.title: A pivot table with sparklines
captions.body: Exact totals computed outside the model, with a trend column for every row.

captions.title: Narrow it to one segment
captions.body: Filters run on disk as well. Only Partner orders from 2026 are loaded.

captions.title: It finds the bad month
captions.body: Partner orders fell to 90 in March. Claude calls it out from the chart summary alone.
